Question ID: Q200
Question: Which asset type has the most alarmed sensor readings?

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT at.type_name, COUNT(sr.alarm_flag) AS alarm_count
   FROM asset_types at
   JOIN assets a ON at.asset_type_id = a.asset_type_id
   JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id
   WHERE sr.alarm_flag = 1
   GROUP BY at.type_name
   ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
   LIMIT 1;

SELECT at.type_name, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count
   FROM sensor_readings sr
   JOIN assets a ON sr.asset_id = a.asset_id
   JOIN asset_types at ON a.asset_type_id = at.asset_type_id
   WHERE sr.alarm_flag = 1
   GROUP BY at.type_name
   ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
   LIMIT 1;

SELECT at.type_name, COUNT(sr.reading_id) AS alarm_count
   FROM asset_types at
   INNER JOIN assets a ON at.asset_type_id = a.asset_type_id
   INNER JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id AND sr.alarm_flag = 1
   GROUP BY at.type_name
   ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
   LIMIT 1;

SELECT at.type_name, COUNT(sr.alarm_flag) AS alarm_count FROM asset_types at JOIN assets a ON at.asset_type_id = a.asset_type_id JOIN sensor_readings sr ON a.asset_id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.alarm_flag = 1 GROUP BY at.type_name ORDER BY alarm_count DESC LIMIT 1;
